_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Ladder score ~40 inside Anxiety with 3% 12h coil base-rate and no rung-breaker; tactical short already expressed on the breakdown remains the active side until reclaim.
next_move.brains_agree: partial: both describe distribution/weakness but analyst alone supplies explicit SHORT + phase-HOLD forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear_greed 20-40, 30d mom near 50, BTC held below 78500 with elevated exchange netflow
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC reclaims and holds above 79000 or momentum/ETF flows push score into Complacency
